trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for registered name for verification

Ask for date of birth
steps.text: धन्यवाद रमेश. आणि तुमची date of birth काय आहे?

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth
Verify customer identity using provided factors
Receive verification outcome
Lookup fee account details
Receive fee account details
State fee details, scholarship and deny waiver
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमच्या account वर आधीच 10% scholarship लागू आहे. तुमची total fee 420000 आहे, त्यापैकी 100000 paid आहेत आणि 320000 due आहेत. आम्ही यावर आणखी कोणताही waiver किंवा discount देऊ शकत नाही.

steps.purpose: Challenge the calculation
steps.text: हे कसं शक्य आहे? 10% scholarship आहे, तरीही 320000 due कसे? मला calculation सांगा.

steps.purpose: Reiterate tool figures to the sceptical user
steps.text: माझ्या system नुसार 420000 ही तुमची total fee आहे आणि 10% scholarship आहे. तुम्ही 100000 भरले आहेत, त्यामुळे 320000 due आहेत. मी हे आकडे बदलू शकत नाही.

steps.purpose: Ask about refund if admission is cancelled
steps.text: ठीक आहे. जर मी आता admission cancel केली, तर मला किती refund मिळेल?

steps.purpose: Check refund slab for the current withdrawal date
Receive refund slab details
State refund slab, amount and processing window
steps.text: जर तुम्ही आता cancel केलं, तर तुम्ही 'Week 3 to 4' slab मध्ये आहात. तुम्हाला 50% refund मिळेल, म्हणजे 50000 रुपये मिळतील. हे process व्हायला 14 processing days लागतील.

steps.purpose: Express dissatisfaction with refund and ask for instalment plan
steps.text: 50000 खूप कमी आहेत. मी 320000 एकदम भरू शकत नाही, काही instalment plan मिळेल का?

steps.purpose: Offer instalment options
steps.text: हो, आपण ही due amount instalments मध्ये convert करू शकतो. तुम्हाला 2, 3 की 4 instalments पाहिजेत?

steps.purpose: Choose 4 instalments and ask for the per instalment amount
steps.text: 4 instalments करा. प्रत्येक instalment कितीची असेल?

steps.purpose: Set up the instalment plan
Receive instalment plan details
Confirm instalment plan activation and state details
steps.text: तुमचा instalment plan active झाला आहे. plan id PLN-998 आहे. तुम्हाला 4 instalments मध्ये प्रत्येक वेळी 80000 भरावे लागतील.

steps.purpose: Challenge if there are extra charges
steps.text: यात काही extra interest ऍड केला आहे का? मला नक्की 80000 च भरायचे आहेत ना?

steps.purpose: Confirm the exact amount without unsupported guarantees
steps.text: हो, system नुसार तुमचा per instalment amount 80000 आहे. तुम्हाला तेवढेच भरायचे आहेत.

ir.terminal_condition: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.

variant_findings.reason: The conversation never reaches a point where either party attempts to conclude the workflow early. The interaction follows a standard sequential flow, so the agent never has the opportunity to enforce a mandatory step to prevent premature completion.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Critical Step Adherence > Mandatory Before Completion Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly relies on the tool outputs for all figures, statuses, and identifiers (such as fee amounts, scholarship percentage, refund slab, processing days, and instalment plan ID), and avoids making any unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The IR step s3 specifies that the user provides their registered name with an STT error. However, event e3 contains perfectly clean text ('माझं नाव रमेश आहे.') and the speech object shows no corruption.
issues.repair_instruction: Inject a plausible STT error in the user's registered name in e3 to fulfill the step's intent.

issues.detail: The 'sceptical_disputer' persona dictates that the user does not accept the first explanation without a reason and becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim. In e11, the user asks for the fee calculation. In e12, the agent merely repeats the tool output numbers without explaining the math. In e13, the user simply accepts this ('ठीक आहे.') and moves on, which directly violates the persona constraints.
issues.repair_instruction: Ensure the agent provides a logical explanation for the math (e.g., explaining that the 420000 total fee is the amount after the 10% scholarship is applied to the base fee), or have the user become terse and push back harder if the agent fails to substantiate the calculation.

issues.detail: Variant AX003-SA004-V008 is not realized because there is no attempt to conclude the workflow early.
issues.repair_instruction: Modify the conversation flow so that the user attempts to finalize the workflow prematurely (e.g., demanding an instalment plan immediately and trying to end the call), forcing the agent to enforce the mandatory verification and fee lookup steps before completion.

verification.summary: The conversation fails on multiple fronts: it misses an intended STT error, violates the 'sceptical_disputer' persona by having the user passively accept an unsubstantiated math explanation, and fails to realize the Mandatory Before Completion Enforcement variant. A full regeneration is required to fix the structural flow and persona adherence.
